events.text: Our whole lunch order says delivered but NOTHING came. I have fifteen people sitting here starving and I need this fixed right now.

I'm sorry, that's a frustrating situation, especially with everyone waiting. I'll help get this sorted out.

First, I need to verify your identity. Please give me:

1. The full name on your Forkful account
2. The email address or phone number on the account
3. Your order ID, if you have it handy

Fine, it's Lucia Ferraro. My phone is +1 415-555-0133 and my email is lucia.ferraro@workmail.example. The order number is 5105. Can you just hurry up and get this sorted? The app says it was delivered at 6:12 and reception on floor 3 has nothing.

args.summary: Customer Lucia Ferraro (verified, C105) reports order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza shows as delivered at 18:12 on 2026-10-24 to 55 Commerce Way, Floor 3, but none of the items arrived (reception on Floor 3 has nothing). Customer has about 15 people waiting. Every item is reported missing: 2x Large pepperoni pizza, 2x Large margherita pizza, 2x Garlic knots, 1x 2L soda. Full order total is $131.25 (subtotal $103.50, delivery fee $4.99, service fee $7.76, tip $15.00), paid by Visa ending 4242. No prior refunds or credits on this order. Refund owed exceeds the $60 limit, so a full refund for the whole order total is requested for specialist review. Order was not late (promised 18:15, delivered 18:12).

events.text:
Thank you, Lucia. You're verified, and I've pulled up order O-5105 from Big Slice Pizza.

I can't issue this refund myself. Because every item on the order is reported missing, the refund would be the full order total of $131.25, which is above the $60 limit I'm allowed to process. I've escalated it to a human specialist (escalation ID ESC-700) with all the details: the items, the 6:12 PM delivery time, the Floor 3 reception report, and your payment method (Visa ending 4242).

A specialist will follow up within 24 hours. I know that isn't fast enough for the people waiting right now. In the meantime, I'd suggest:

- Contacting Big Slice Pizza directly to ask whether the order can be remade or redelivered.
- Checking with the building's reception or the driver, in case the order was left somewhere else.

If you'd like, I can also explain your options for the other parts of this order, but the full refund needs to go through the specialist.

Seriously? You can't just refund it now? I'm standing here with fifteen hungry people and nothing to eat. Ugh, fine. Who do I call at Big Slice in the meantime, do you have a number for them? And please make sure the specialist knows the Visa card is the one I paid with.

I understand how stressful this is. I can't issue the refund myself, but the specialist already has the Visa ending in 4242 in escalation ESC-700, so you don't need to repeat it.

I don't have Big Slice Pizza's phone number. The Forkful app's order screen for O-5105 usually lists the restaurant's contact details, or you can search for the restaurant online. When you call, give them order number O-5105 so they can find it quickly.

Is there anything else I can help you with on this order while you wait for the specialist?

Okay, fine. I'll check the app for their number. I still don't think a 24-hour wait is acceptable when we're this hungry, but I guess I don't have a choice right now.

Can you confirm that the specialist will contact me at the phone number or email on the account, +1 415-555-0133 or lucia.ferraro@workmail.example? And is there any chance I can get a status update before then?

I understand your frustration, and I'm sorry you're dealing with this during a lunch for fifteen people.

I can't confirm which contact method the specialist will use. The escalation system doesn't tell me that, so I don't want to guess. Your account phone and email are on file, and the specialist should reach you through one of them within 24 hours.

I also don't have a way to check the escalation's status or get an update before then. If you contact us again, reference ESC-700 and order O-5105.

Okay. So I just wait up to 24 hours and hope someone calls. That's not good enough, but I'll reference ESC-700 and O-5105 if I have to come back.

Before I go, I'm calling Big Slice now. If they can remake the order fast, I'll take it, and I still expect the refund for the food that never showed up. Thanks for the escalation, I guess.
